api.description: Same-origin JSON client with the standard error envelope and an injected auth-expiry hook.

pwa.description: Service-worker registration and update lifecycle (onUpdate); the service worker itself is installed by template (copy it on upgrade; app code goes in sw-app.js).

pwa-shell.description: iOS-standalone-safe mobile shell: large-viewport height, keyboard handling, nav as the last flex child, published nav height.

profile.description: The signed-in person bottom left (photo from directory) opening a menu: de/en, light/dark, the app's own settings and the person's other apps; backend: Go package profile at /api/me.

pull-refresh.description: usePullToRefresh on the shell's scroller: standalone touch only, from the top, sideways swipes ignored, damping, threshold, minimum spin, off while a dialog is open; indicator app-owned.

sheet.description: Bottom-sheet behaviour on a native <dialog>: top layer, scroll lock on the shell's scroller, safe area, Escape for the topmost, focus back to the opener, drag down to close; look app-owned.

toast.description: Headless toast store (queue, durations, undo, pause, status/alert) and an unstyled ToastRegion in the top layer above the nav; look app-owned.

template.description: Minimal React/Vite application with app-owned content, theme, query policy, top bar and nav on the shared shell.
